# MetroFuse 10.0 Beta 13

- Added host support for the separately installed Telegram Audio plugin, including track metadata, secure account storage and Android loopback streaming.
- Fixed enabled plugins being lost when the app moves to the background. Re-enabling a plugin also clears its recovery block.

Install the signed APK over your current Android beta. On Windows, extract the x64 ZIP and run the launcher. Import Telegram Audio separately under Settings ? Plugins.
